svg.title: One shared MCP tool surface
svg.desc: With per-account servers, two accounts can expose 108 tool definitions to a session. acctmux presents one set of 54 definitions with an account selector. This example reflects the 54-tool Google Workspace upstream used in the benchmark.

g.text: Example: Google Workspace MCP, 54 upstream tool definitions
The selector chooses the identity at call time; tool names are not duplicated per account.
